requirement.original_request: Create an English, paper-ready stacked bar chart from the verified v5 results. Compare contract cost and emergency cost across four Problem 3 rolling-update policies. Highlight, but do not overstate, the selected raw-PV policy. Use a clean scientific style, muted colours, readable units, no 3D, no pie chart and no significance stars.
requirement.goal: Compare the cost composition of four Problem 3 rolling-update policies.

requirement.original_request: Create an English, paper-ready dual-axis bar-and-line time-series chart from the verified v5 monthly paired comparisons. Show monthly realized savings and cumulative savings for the Q4-2 and Q4-3 OLS-versus-fixed planning-price comparisons. Positive saving means the OLS candidate is cheaper. Use a clean scientific style, muted colours, readable units, no 3D and no pie chart.
requirement.goal: Compare monthly and cumulative realized savings for two Q4 price-planning comparisons.
